comments.author: Trollo
comments.body:
Hey guys, I need some advice and some tips. I main trade, almost all my skills are for trade, only few are for battle (like 4 or 5); I need to lvl up maritime, at the moment my trade lvl is 44 and battle is 15, I need to reach lvl 21 battle to use a big trading galleon a friend gave it to me for free, the galleon is nice: nice speed, nice cargo and it have skill but I can't use it because I don't meet battle requirements...

Where I can lvl up fast? Some guy from my company tookme to SEA to lvl up but I can't do sh*t there, even the meekest trade NPC fleet is hard for me to defeat; maybe if I run some dungeons with a friend? I was thinking of doing bordeaux upper floor to lvl up and get some trade goods too, what do you think?

comments.author: Cash
comments.body:
I would strongly suggest finishing maritime school in battle job to reap the full exp which should get you to level 21. The one quest prior to the final exam (some fleets near Sassari if I can remember) can be done over and over again as well, so maybe focus on that one.. Bordeaux at your level may be too hard.

GL!
